# Data retention FAQ (draft)

Draft. Not reviewed. See [terms](../glossary/terms.md).

## How long do you keep my data after I leave?
We keep it for 90 days after you close your account, then delete it.

## Can I ask for faster deletion?
Yes, write to support. The full rules are in the [retention policy](data-retention.md).
